Container.Name: dumbscope
Container.Overview:
DUMBscope — observe your entire DUMB media stack. A self-hosted control center for DUMB (Distributed Unlimited Media Bridge): realtime service health, dependency topology, incident correlation, live logs and system metrics. One container, one /config volume, no Docker socket, no external database.
On first start, open the WebUI and enter the setup code printed in the container log (docker logs dumbscope).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port DUMBscope's web interface listens on

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent DUMBscope config, database and secrets

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns /config (Unraid default: nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns /config (Unraid default: users)

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for files created inside /config

Config.Name: DUMB_URL (optional)
Config.Description: Pre-configure the DUMB gateway URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:3005). Leave empty to set it in the setup wizard instead.

Config.Name: DUMBSCOPE_TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to true ONLY when running behind a reverse proxy that terminates HTTPS, so session cookies get the Secure flag

Config.Name: DUMBSCOPE_HTTPS
Config.Description: Set to true ONLY when DUMBscope itself serves real HTTPS, to force the Secure flag on cookies
